notes: EXAMPLE, not a machine's real configuration, and UNVERIFIED: no rule here has ever run on Windows. Realistic profile: a browser with the declared tabs, a chat app idle, a terminal running several sessions of a coding-agent CLI, idle for the whole run. Copy to workloads/local-nominal-windows.json, fill in the <placeholders> (%LOCALAPPDATA% and other environment variables are expanded) and pass it with --workload.

groups.name: coding_agent_cli
groups.notes: A terminal coding-agent CLI. A session is a process of that CLI whose parent is not one.

groups.name: coding_agent_children
groups.notes: Descendants of a session that are not the CLI itself (MCP servers, node, shells).
